item.title: American Samoa wins key albacore protections at WCPFC22
item.description: MANILA, Philippines – The 22nd Regular Session of the Western and Central Pacific Fisheries Commission (WCPFC22) concluded Friday with a unanimous decision securing the long-term future of the South Pacific albacore fishery—a major win for the American Samoa longline fleet managed by the Western Pacific Fishery Management Council. item.title: Nnena Kalu wins the 2025 Turner Prize
item.description: The Scottish artist, who was nominated for works shown at the Walker Art Gallery and Manifesta 15, is the first learning-disabled person to claim the prestigious award. item.description: (AP) — Shohei Ohtani is catching up with more legends. item.title: Registration portal now open for Rota Marathon 2026
item.description: (PR) – The online registration portal of the Rota Marathon 2026 is now open. The online portal is https://mva.mymarianas.com/rota-marathon-registration/.
